name: taskboard
description: Full-stack task manager with a Playwright quality gate

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run start -w backend" "npm run preview -w frontend"
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run build
